title: Modern America — 2025
description: You take your seat at the dawn of a turbulent administration. The nation is divided, the economy is wobbling, and both parties are gearing up for the next cycle. Will you steer the ship, or be run aground?

victoryConditions.description: Maintain a nationwide average happiness of 60 for a full year.

summary: A divided capital. A fragile economy. A first term.
